charge_gauge_scope: q0: neutral H/D probe adds one electron; q1: bare unit-charge probe adds none. Occupied and target-removed hosts are neutral, differing by one nucleus and one electron. Matched same-cell probe charges cancel a gauge/background constant proportional to q^2 within each quartet, not between unlike charges or cells. Residual finite-cell electronic and multipole effects are checked at R=0.1 A for BOTH F charges.

scope: Static target-conditioned BO total interactions at the six supplied radii only. F uses freshly force-relaxed finite FD cells at the original PBE PW500/k4 LiD volume; this is not FD volume/stress reoptimization.
